body: I liked this duo at first, but then I didn't know what happened, they didn't seem fun to me anymore. This movie is not good, but it is one of the unforgettable movies. A little funny, a little fun.
One of the worst movies I have ever have seen. Deserved a zero rating but minimum was 1 so i gave it a 1, but in all honestly even a 1 rating is to much for this movie!

This movie is a complete waste of time. Even one point is too much. Stay away; it's not worth your time. It's unclear what kind of mindset the writer had while writing it or what the director was thinking while filming. Overacted performances, forced comedy. Those who give high ratings are either the filmmakers themselves or an audience that doesn't know much about movies.

I don't understand why they make movies like this. There are so many better stories to tell. Comedy can be done without exaggerated facial expressions and over-the-top gestures. They could actually put some effort into writing something funny instead of relying on forced humor. Seriously, don't waste your time.

not as good as expected, the cast is very good very good acting but boring typical story, i would probably prefer this over 'Recep Ivedik' series for sure but its disappointment after watching their TV series they come up with this, what a waste. Gotta say 'Patlak Sokaklar' , a film i wasn't aware, not much advertised is far more better intact funnies i watched last 2-3 years. anyway if you have nothing to watch and you got this film for or on Television its all right otherwise don't pay money or special time for this film. rasim osturk acting is great as usual while ahmet and murat is alright i say, some of the jokes were really funny but only few, and the story is so lame that when i wathced it i was like is this all they come up with, what a waste and u expect me to pay to watch dugun dernek 2 in ur dreams mate(well i didn't pay for this either :))
